The gravitational field strength at the surface of the Earth varies slightly from place to place.
At the South Pole it is 9.86N/kg and in London it is 9.81N/kg.
An explorer collects a rock at the South Pole and moves it to London.
How does moving the rock from the South Pole to London affect the mass and the weight of
the rock?
